kicker: Tencent Hy4 preview, from its weights

scenes.headline: How Hy4 preview is built, read from its weights
scenes.sub: Tencent's 770B MoE: gated sparse attention, IndexCache, ternary weights
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Tassel! Tencent's Hy4 preview is a seven hundred seventy billion parameter mixture of experts. Here's how it's built, read straight from its weight files.

scenes.label: IndexCache
scenes.text: Only 21 of 78 layers compute their own sparse-attention index. The other 57 reuse a nearby layer's, and their indexer weights don't exist.
scenes.say: Only twenty-one of seventy-eight layers compute their own sparse-attention index. The other fifty-seven reuse a nearby layer's, so their indexer weights don't exist at all.

steps.say: A token passes through seventy-eight layers, carried on four parallel residual streams. Each layer first squeezes keys and values into a small latent.

steps.note: DeepSeek Sparse Attention, with a gate on its output
steps.say: Attention is DeepSeek's sparse attention, guided by a sparse-attention index, with a learned gate on its output.
Only twenty-one layers own that indexer. The rest reuse a nearby layer's index, and the weights they'd need were never shipped: five hundred thirty-four million parameters.
Then a router picks eight of two hundred fifty-six experts, plus one shared. About forty-nine billion parameters are active per token.

steps.label: trained weights, before quantizing
steps.say: Tencent's own GGUF packs twenty-nine layers into a ternary format. Take a block of two hundred fifty-six trained weights.

steps.label: STQ1_0: -d, 0 or +d, one in four zero
steps.say: Each becomes minus d, zero, or plus d, and exactly one in every four is zero. That packs down to one point three one two five bits a weight.

scenes.label: Headline benchmarks where Hy4 preview leads
scenes.say: Among open-weight models, it leads five of its twelve headline benchmarks. Add the two closed frontier models, and it leads one. The card claims only the first.

scenes.text: IndexCache doesn't skip a computation at inference time; it removes the weights that would do that computation.

recap: 21 layers index; 57 reuse and store none
scenes.say: To recap: eight of two hundred fifty-six experts, a sparse-attention index shared across layers, and ternary weights.
